import pandas as pd
import openpyxl
from pathlib import Path

# Load the spreadsheet
spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/418-29/1_418-29_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/418-29_2_fb8c09e1/1_418-29_output.xlsx"

            net_value = values[0] - sum(values[1:])

            net_value = row['Value']
        
        # Add to result (only first occurrence)
        result_rows.append({'Reference': ref, 'Value': net_value})
        processed_refs.add(ref)

# Create result DataFrame

# Write the result data (without headers)

# Save the workbook

print(f"\nFile saved to {output_path}")
